additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
252 mana, 1.05 mana regeneration and 2.1% flat base magic resistance.
21 main attack damage to all / / heroes.
44.1 main attack damage to universal heroes.
Cannot dominate creep-heroes, Siege Creeps, Necronomicon Archers, Necronomicon Warriors, and Roshan.
Applies a basic dispel on the creep upon cast.
Dominating a creep while already having one dominated instantly kills the previously dominated creep.
The number of max allowed units is bound to the player. Buying a new Helm of the Overlord does not allow dominating an additional unit.
Sets the creep's movement speed to 380, regardless of its default movement speed.
Sets the creep's gold bounty to 250, regardless of its default bounty.
When the creep's max health is below the min health threshold, its current and max health are increased by the difference. This counts as setting health.
Attack damage bonus is added directly to the creep's base attack damage.
Does not restore the creep's mana.
Reinforced units receive 10% less damage (before reductions) from the dominated creep.
Increases the creep's abilities' level based on the time dominated and does not upgrade. For a full list of neutral creep abilities that are upgradeable, please refer to the chart below.
Does not share cooldowns with Helm of the Dominator.
This ability's cooldown is not refreshed by Rearm.
Ancient Black Drake – Magic Amplification Aura
Ancient Frostbitten Golem – Time Warp Aura
description: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.
tips: Dominated creeps can be used to remotely stack an ancient camp. Some creeps have abilities that are very useful, such as Dark Troll Summoner and Ogre Frostmage.
You can dominate the Alpha Wolf for the helpful damage aura and have it follow your carry.
A dominated creep can be used as a scout that can be placed inside Roshan's pit. Just be sure not to place it too close to Roshan, so he does not attack it.

Dominate always sets the creep's base movement speed to 380. The only units which have more than 425 movement speed are Lycan Wolves at level 3 or higher. This means dominating one of them actually reduces their base speed down to 380. Besides these, all other dominatable creeps have lower movement speed than 380.
recommendedFor: With the Pack Leader facet, the dominated creep gains hasted move speed and a crit strike during Shapeshift. The creep will also gain bonus damage from Feral Impulse, making this a core item on Lycan

Inner Beast gives the ancient creeps higher attack speed, which is helpful as neutral creeps have a slow attack speed and animation. Buff can be increased further with Assault Cuirass and Drum of Endurance

notes: Can also Dominate enemy lane creeps and summoned units.
Selling will cause dominated units to die.
abilities.description:
Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1900. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1900 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

name: Helm of the Overlord
